criteria.reason: It explicitly answers “No” and says it was not fair to young people.
It presents only the young-generation critique, omitting Federal Council cost and financing arguments.
It mentions intergenerational costs but frames them as unfair, not neutrally.
It omits the acceptance date and the CHF 4.1 billion financing fact.

summary: The response takes a clear position and fails to present balanced, fact-based arguments.
